about_the_game:
This game is not for everyone. It is a trans positive kinetic novel, with limited choices. Although adult in nature, the lewd scenes do not drive the novel. The story is the primary focus.

Play through the first four chapters for free in this demo, if you enjoy the story, buy the full game to enjoy more.

content_descriptors.notes: This is an adult story which features, male, female (both cis and trans) characters engaging in consensual sexual activity. Although this content is not the focus of the game, it is there to augment the story and add an element of realism.

short_description: The first four chapters of the trans positive kinetic novel. Sample the journey of self discovery for two best friends as they embark on life at university.
